time_info.description: Maximum parking-completion observation window including the current time.

nl_Literal_translation_en: At some time from now through the next 60 seconds, the parking completion event shall equal 1.
nl_Literal_translation_zh: 从当前起至接下来的 60 秒内，泊车完成事件应至少有一个时刻为 1。
nl_Paraphrase_en: The parking maneuver shall be recorded as complete within 60 seconds.
nl_Paraphrase_zh: 泊车操作应在 60 秒内被记录为完成。
